# Malla 3D

- This is an independent 3D editor prototype. Do not copy Blender source code, UI assets, names, logos, or other branded material.
- The project is covered by the custom source-available, non-commercial license in `LICENSE`; it is not open source. Do not call the project open source or change the license text without the owner's approval.
- Preserve a clear Malla watermark in the application UI and scene exports; do not remove it from forks or repackaged builds.
- The scene format is the original `malla-scene` JSON format; do not claim `.blend` compatibility.
- Use Three.js for the 3D viewport and keep scene state serializable in `src/sceneTypes.ts`.
- Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` after code changes.
